subject: SkyBank onboarding: identity controls & service account runway
messages:
From: Paul Stubbs <paul.stubbs@skybank.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: SkyBank access controls for Redwood rollout

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — our security and platform teams want to get the identity side of the Redwood rollout squared away before our pilot. High-level requirements:
- Single sign-on: Okta (SAML) for Redwood Console access, want IdP-initiated + SP-initiated flows tested.
- User provisioning: SCIM push from Okta, group->role mapping required.
- IP allowlist: we need to allow Redwood management IPs for admin callbacks and API access.
- Service accounts: a few non-human service accounts for nightly batch jobs that call Redwood APIs; need naming conventions and minimum permissions.
- Org policies: enforce MFA, session timeouts, and conditional access for admin roles.

Can you send: the minimal inventory template we should fill (users, groups, admin contacts), a recommended SAML attribute map, and a suggested timeline? We are aiming to start technical onboarding the week of Mar 27 (preferably 3/28).

I've attached a starter inventory export: skybank-sso-scim-inventory.csv (fields: user_email, okta_id, group_memberships).

Procurement: procurement@skybank.com is on copy — they will need the commercial/ordering docs after the technical kick.

Paul
Paul Stubbs
Director, Cloud Identity & Access
SkyBank
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Paul — thanks, this is exactly the right level to start. A few quick responses and next steps:

1) Support & patterns
- We fully support Okta SAML (both IdP- and SP-initiated flows) and SCIM v2 provisioning.
- We can map Okta groups to Redwood RBAC roles; Jonas will include recommended attributes for group sync.

2) Service account guidance
- We recommend short-lived tokens for all non-human accounts with an automated rotation cadence (30/60 days depending on sensitivity).
- Naming convention suggestion: svc-redwood-{env}-{purpose} (example: svc-redwood-prod-batch).

3) IP allowlists
- We can provide a set of static egress IPs or SNI-based allowlist guidance depending on your network posture. See the attached template for the CIDR list.

4) Materials attached
- redwood-onboard-playbook-v1.pdf — high-level checklist + typical timelines
- skybank-sso-scim-inventory.csv — I kept your file and added a column for 'test_account' we often ask for

5) Proposed immediate next step
- 60m technical kickoff to cover SAML metadata exchange, SCIM attribute mapping, service account scopes, and test-matrix. Suggested time: Tue, Mar 28 10:00 PDT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

6) Commercials
- Marissa (cc'd) will confirm the order form and start the DocuSign packet for procurement.

Action items (initial):
- SkyBank: share Okta org metadata and a test user (preferably an Okta admin test account).
- Redwood: send SAML SP metadata and a SCIM token generator link; draft service account naming & perms.

Looking forward — I'll coordinate the invite once you confirm.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-03-15T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: SkyBank access controls for Redwood rollout

Adding a few technical specifics that we should confirm during the kickoff:

- SAML: required fields
  - ACS URL: https://auth.redwood.ai/saml/acs
  - SP Entity ID: urn:redwood:sp:prod
  - Required assertions: email, given_name, family_name, groups (groups optional but recommended)
  - NameID format: emailAddress

- SCIM: attribute recommendations
  - id, userName (email), name.givenName, name.familyName, active, externalId, emails[type=work]
  - group handling: we recommend pushing Okta groups with externalId mapped to Redwood role names (avoid special characters)
  - token rotation: recommend automated rotation every 30 days for prod service accounts; 60 days acceptable for non-critical environments

- Service accounts
  - Preferred naming: svc-redwood-{env}-{purpose} (e.g., svc-redwood-prod-batch)
  - Permissions: minimal scope to call inference APIs; no console admin unless explicitly required
  - Audit: any service account usage should be logged to your SIEM — we will expose token last-used timestamps in the audit logs feed

- IP allowlist
  - If you need static CIDRs, we can provide a published set for east/us-west; otherwise we support a short-lived tunnel model. I attached a simple template: skybank-ip-allowlist.csv

If Paul can confirm the Okta test user and group mapping goals (e.g., groups -> environment roles), I can prepare the sample SAML metadata and a SCIM mapping doc before the kickoff.

- Jonas
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
